definitions: An informal group or community of individuals, typically from Tunisia, who share a strong interest and passion for computer programming and related fields.
A potential name for a social media group, online forum, or club dedicated to programming enthusiasts in Tunisia.
examples: The Tunisian Programming Lovers often meet online to discuss new technologies.
She joined the Tunisian Programming Lovers to improve her coding skills.
Many members of Tunisian Programming Lovers contribute to open-source projects.
